capacity:worker.title: Readers can't keep up
capacity:worker.message: At the diagram's own rates, it gets 64/s and handles 12/s (533%): its backlog only grows. Assigned instances: 3 / 8 · Shards.
capacity:worker.rationale: Demand above what a service can handle never drains: latency and backlog grow until something times out. Live view's Show capacity has the same numbers.

fix.label: Set replicas to 30 and Events: Shards → 30

no-reader:dead.title: Dead letters pile up in Recovery
no-reader:dead.message: Nothing in the diagram reads or alerts on Recovery: failed messages stay there until someone looks.
no-reader:dead.rationale: A dead-letter queue has no automatic cleanup. Someone should be told when messages land there, and be able to replay them.

fix.label: Add a reader…
fix.choice: Pick what reads Recovery, then add it and connect dead to it.
